_readme: Copy this file (e.g. to new_batch.json), fill the fields you have, then run: python src/build_deck.py --repo <main worktree> --new-batch new_batch_results/new_batch.json. Either point to main's own output (categorise_csv or webapp_json, paths relative to this file) and let the row be generated, or write the observations yourself. Any text field you fill overrides the generated text. Leave unused fields empty.
